name: sherlock
network: outbound HTTP(S) to the public sites being tested
review_notes: Sherlock checks whether a username exists using public HTTP requests.
A hit proves the username exists, NOT who owns the account.
It tests a large number of sites: keep concurrency low and respect quotas.
No credential is required; no secret is stored for this plugin.
On every upstream bump, re-check setup.py/pyproject and the absence of any dynamic download of the site list from a non-official source.
